description: This file contains the implementation of SparkHadoopWriter, a utility object for writing RDDs to Hadoop-compatible storage using Hadoop OutputFormats, along with helper classes for configuring and managing Hadoop job and task contexts, commit protocols, and record writers in both old (mapred) and new (mapreduce) Hadoop APIs.
external_files: org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.{JobContext, OutputFormat, RecordWriter, TaskAttemptContext, TaskAttemptID, TaskType}

classes.name: HadoopMapRedWriteConfigUtil
classes.description: Helper class for configuring Hadoop MapReduce API job contexts, output formats, commit protocols, and record writers using the old mapred API.

classes.name: HadoopMapReduceWriteConfigUtil
classes.description: Helper class for configuring Hadoop MapReduce API job contexts, output formats, commit protocols, and record writers using the new mapreduce API.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Main method to write an RDD to Hadoop storage using specified configuration, handling job setup, execution, and commit.

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Writes a single RDD partition within a Spark task, managing task setup, writing records, and cleanup.
